# Example estate

> Architecture catalog of Example estate: 4 bounded contexts, 7 services, 12 aggregates, 7 stores, 25 flows and 3 decision records, read from the code, the specs and the traces of the estate.

*Generated from the portolan catalog · commit `5 sources` · at 2026-08-29T09:14:22Z. Do not edit by hand.*

Every link below is a markdown page beside this file. [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) is all of those pages in one file, in the order the site lists them.

## Contexts

- [Shop](shop/README.md): core. Everything the customer touches before money moves: baskets, orders and prices
- [Payments](payments/README.md): core. A double-entry ledger and the PSP integrations that feed it. Nothing here knows what an order is for
- [Delivery](delivery/README.md): supporting. Routes, parcels and proof of delivery. Reacts to captured payments, never to placed orders
- [Authentication](auth/README.md): core. Who someone is, and whether they are still logged in. The only service in the estate that stores credentials, and the only one allowed to mint or revoke a session

## Services

- [Pricing](shop/pricing/README.md): in Shop. Aggregates: Quote, PriceList
- [Billing](shop/billing/README.md): in Shop. Aggregates: Invoice
- [Shopping Cart](shop/cart/README.md): in Shop. Aggregates: Basket
- [Order Management](shop/oms/README.md): in Shop. Aggregates: Order
- [Ledger](payments/ledger/README.md): in Payments. Aggregates: Payment, Refund
- [Delivery Core](delivery/core/README.md): in Delivery. Aggregates: Shipment, Route
- [Authentication & Sessions](auth/auth/README.md): in Authentication. Aggregates: Lockout, Session, User

## Flows

- [Gateway webhook](flows/gateway-webhook.md): owned by [payments](payments/README.md). The gateway's side of the story, arriving after the fact. One signed callback, four ways to read it: a replay to ignore, a capture to record, a charge with no local payment to adopt, and a failure to pass on. The adopt branch is the only repair for a checkout that timed out mid-authorization, and it is the one branch no test covers
- [Quote expired on checkout](flows/quote-expired-on-checkout.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). A basket that has been checked out is a basket whose quote is spent. Pricing hears the event the cart publishes and expires the quote it issued for that basket, so a second checkout of the same basket has to be priced again rather than reuse a number the price list may have moved on from
- [Shipment tracking](flows/shipment-tracking.md): owned by [delivery](delivery/README.md). Reconstructed from production traces over a 24 hour window: the tracking page, the carrier's scan webhook, and what each scan code sets off. Two things only the traces know about — a consumer no repository accounts for, and an exception path whose reader emits no spans at all
- [Change password](flows/auth-change-password.md): owned by [auth](auth/README.md). Replaces the password of a user, given the current one
- [Get user](flows/auth-get-user.md): owned by [auth](auth/README.md). Reads a user by id
- [Login](flows/auth-login.md): owned by [auth](auth/README.md). Turns credentials into a session
- [Logout](flows/auth-logout.md): owned by [auth](auth/README.md). Ends the session behind a token
- [Register user](flows/auth-register-user.md): owned by [auth](auth/README.md). Creates a user from an email address and a password
- [Validate session](flows/auth-validate-session.md): owned by [auth](auth/README.md). Resolves a token to a live session: who is calling, and how long the answer stays good
- [Revoke sessions on password change](flows/auth-revoke-sessions-on-password-change.md): owned by [auth](auth/README.md). Ends the sessions issued against a password that has just been replaced
- [Invoice create](flows/billing-invoice-create.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Draws up a draft invoice for an order, with a line for each thing sold
- [Invoice destroy](flows/billing-invoice-destroy.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Ends an invoice nobody is going to pay
- [Invoice issue](flows/billing-invoice-issue.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Confirms the session, freezes the invoice and asks the customer to pay
- [Invoice retrieve](flows/billing-invoice-retrieve.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Reads one invoice and the lines it is made of
- [Close invoice on payment](flows/billing-close-invoice-on-payment.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Closes the invoice for an order once the ledger says the money arrived
- [Add item](flows/cart-add-item.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md)
- [Checkout](flows/cart-checkout.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md)
- [Create basket](flows/cart-create-basket.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md)
- [Get basket](flows/cart-get-basket.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md)
- [Merge baskets](flows/cart-merge-baskets.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md)
- [Remove item](flows/cart-remove-item.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md)
- [Cancel order](flows/oms-cancel-order.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Answers with the order as it is now; a cancelled order is still found
- [Get order](flows/oms-get-order.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Answers with the order as it is now; a cancelled order is still found
- [Confirm order on payment authorized](flows/oms-confirm-order-on-payment-authorized.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Confirms the order once the payment for it is authorised (ADR oms.0005). Declared ahead of its publisher: nothing in the estate says `payments.PaymentAuthorized` yet, and the catalog says so
- [Place order on basket checked out](flows/oms-place-order-on-basket-checked-out.md): owned by [shop](shop/README.md). Places the order the basket was checked out for (ADR oms.0002). The order takes the basket's id, so the same checkout heard twice places one order

## Decisions

- [org.0001](adr/org.0001.md): Client proto copies live in the consumer's infrastructure layer (accepted, 2025-03-11)
- [org.0002](adr/org.0002.md): Domain event schema version is encoded in the package path (events/v1) (accepted, 2025-05-02)
- [payments.0004](adr/payments.0004.md): Journal entries are idempotent by (order_id, attempt) (proposed, 2026-02-09)
